categories.main_business_segments: Hansol Technics operates primarily in the electrical/electronic components, EMS, and energy solutions sectors. Its main divisions include power modules (power boards) for TVs and home appliances, LCD modules (LCM), smartphone EMS manufacturing, solar module production, LED wafer processing, and semiconductor equipment parts processing and coating through its subsidiary Hansol Iones. The company also engages in automotive electronic parts and other electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including precision machining, cleaning, and coating for semiconductor equipment parts. It employs switching mode power supply (SMPS) technology for power modules, assembly and processing for LCD modules, and wafer processing for LED materials. Hansol Iones provides a one-stop solution from design to processing, cleaning, coating, measurement, and analysis for semiconductor parts. The company also invests in R&D for plasma coating, ceramic powders, and next-generation semiconductor process materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hansol Technics serves global top-tier customers in the TV, home appliance, smartphone, and semiconductor industries. Its products are used in premium TV models, smartphones and tablets, solar power generation systems, LED lighting and TV chips, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The company’s semiconductor parts are supplied to major domestic and international semiconductor equipment manufacturers. The automotive electronics division targets vehicle interior and exterior electronic components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates domestically in South Korea with offices and factories in Seoul, Jincheon, Cheongju, and Anseong, and internationally through subsidiaries in Thailand, Vietnam, China, and Slovakia. It maintains a global supply chain to serve customers worldwide, including major markets in North America, Europe, China, India, Southeast Asia, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hansol Technics operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and assembling electronic components and modules for OEMs and end-product manufacturers. Through its subsidiary Hansol Iones, it also provides upstream precision processing and coating services for semiconductor equipment parts, offering integrated solutions from design to final processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on strengthening core businesses such as power modules, wireless charging modules, and semiconductor parts while actively pursuing new growth engines through related fields and M&A. R&D efforts emphasize advanced plasma coating technologies, ceramic powder development, next-generation semiconductor materials, and high-efficiency solar modules. It aims to enhance product differentiation, cost competitiveness, and expand into semiconductor equipment parts with high entry barriers.
categories.revenue_model: Hansol Technics generates revenue primarily through product sales of electronic components, modules, and semiconductor equipment parts. It also earns from EMS manufacturing services for smartphones and tablets, solar module sales, and LED wafer processing. Revenue streams include domestic and export sales, with payment methods such as cash, notes, letters of credit, and telegraphic transfers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in highly competitive markets including electronic components for TVs, smartphones, solar modules, and semiconductor equipment parts. It holds a strong position domestically and internationally, especially in semiconductor parts processing and coating through Hansol Iones, which is recognized for superior quality, delivery, and cost competitiveness. The LED wafer business faces intense competition from Chinese manufacturers. The company maintains market leadership in power modules for premium TV models and wireless charging modules.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Hansol Technics reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 1.3 trillion in 2023, a slight decrease from KRW 1.36 trillion in 2022, mainly due to semiconductor industry downturn and completion of large solar projects. Operating profit was KRW 48.9 billion in 2023. The company is classified as a mid-sized enterprise with total assets around KRW 954 billion and equity of KRW 474 billion as of 2023 year-end. It has shown growth in power module sales and maintains stable profitability despite market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hansol Technics emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced electronic components and modules with strong manufacturing capabilities. Its semiconductor subsidiary offers unique one-stop solutions integrating design, precision machining, cleaning, and coating, providing superior cost and delivery competitiveness. The company differentiates through premium product offerings in power modules for TVs, advanced wireless charging modules, and high-efficiency solar modules. Continuous R&D and strategic investments support innovation and customer-specific solutions.
